== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original protects cards from opponent placement in your Used Pile below 13 cards in hand. The 2003 version narrows that protection to transfers from your hand. The later slip instead refers to those cards and retains the 13-card threshold. All three keep the move-phase cost and alternatives. The later wording uses a singular action under the period One Rule.
